signals_info.description: Ego-vehicle speed during the parking maneuver.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At all times, the ego vehicle speed shall be less than 5 kilometers per hour.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在所有时刻，自车速度应低于 5 千米每小时。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Throughout the parking maneuver, the vehicle shall remain below 5 km/h.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 整个泊车过程中，车辆速度应始终低于 5 千米每小时。
